title: Refund notes
doc:
Refund notes, copied from our support chat.

For now, eligible and fraud_hold are the only inputs, and both are booleans (true or false).

Yep, every eligible order gets a refund.
Also, Fraud hold means manual review, always.
If nothing above applies, reject the refund.
